title: Safe Deposit Boxes: late rent, the grace period, the late fee and past due status
content:
## Scope

This policy governs a Safe Deposit Boxes rental whose yearly rent has not been paid on time: when the late fee is charged, when the rental becomes past due, what past due status means for vault access, and how the rental returns to active.

## Policy clause

1. A year's rent left unpaid within 30 calendar days after the rent due date incurs the late fee and makes the rental past due.
2. The grace days are counted with the day after the rent due date as day 1. The late fee and past due status apply when the rent is still unpaid after the end of the last grace day; the last grace day itself is still within the grace period. The late fee is dated the first day after the grace period. The rent due date is taken from the bank's record of that rental.
3. One late fee is charged per rental year, however long the rent stays unpaid.
4. While the rental is past due or drill pending, vault access is refused.
5. Paying everything due returns the rental to active.
6. A late fee charged contrary to this policy, or granted as a courtesy while the customer's courtesy waivers in the rolling 365 days are below the courtesy allowance, is credited under the rules for rent and fee credits.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Late fee per rental year paid late | Grace period after the rent due date | Vault access refused while past due or drill pending |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $15.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $15.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $20.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $25.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $25.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $30.00 | 30 calendar days | Yes |

## Grace period: boundary timeline

Hypothetical rent due date of 1 March, for a 5x10 box.

| Date | Grace count | Rent paid by the end of this day | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | Rent due date, not counted | Yes | No late fee |
| 2 March | Day 1 | Yes | No late fee |
| 31 March | Day 30, the last grace day | Yes | No late fee; the rent was paid within the grace period |
| 1 April | First day after the grace period | Rent still unpaid | Late fee of $20.00, dated 1 April; the rental is past due |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| The due date is day 1, so the grace period ends on 30 March. | Day 1 is the day after the due date; with a 1 March due date the last grace day is 31 March. |
| Rent paid on the last grace day is late. | The late fee applies only when the rent is still unpaid after the end of the last grace day. |
| A further late fee is added each month the rent stays unpaid. | One late fee is charged per rental year, however long the rent stays unpaid. |

## Basis Q&A

**The rental is past due and the lessee wants to open the box today. Is access possible?** No. Vault access is refused while the rental is past due or drill pending.

**What brings the rental back to active?** Paying everything due.

**A late fee was charged even though the rent was paid within the grace days. What applies?** A late fee charged contrary to this policy is credited under the rules for rent and fee credits.
